bom.notes_from_assembler: The 12-pole distribution board may be undersized if a garage sub-board, EV charger, or future circuits are anticipated — worth confirming circuit count with the engineer. Cabling, conduit, cable trays, circuit breakers/RCDs, and labour are not included in this BOM and should be added as separate allowances. The single exhaust fan count appears low for a dwelling with both a bathroom and laundry; confirm whether a second unit is required.
